responseExtra.revision: closest project snapshot revision <= requested N

notes: Workspace build hash is exact SHA256 canonical file manifest; immutable versions retained forever until explicit operator cleanup.
CORS Access-Control-Allow-Origin:* is limited to immutable workspace files for opaque-origin sandbox ES imports. APIs never allow wildcard CORS.
Watcher polls each second, requires 400ms stable source, checks JS syntax with node --check, never executes source build scripts.
Broken source leaves last valid latest/url with status:error. Parent keeps old iframe until new candidate ready.
Parent shell owns APIs, credentials, chat, URLs and mutation authorization. Opaque iframe uses nonce-bound parent RPC.
Runtime and stable releases must be outside agent-writable data and workspace source roots.
